questions.question: Find the antonym of ‘Impute’.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Support**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Impute"** means to attribute or assign something, especially a fault or wrongdoing, to someone or something. (आरोप लगाना)

 
 
• **Example:** The manager imputed the delay to the workers' lack of efficiency.
 
 
 
• **"Support"** refers to providing assistance, backing, or help to someone or something, which is the opposite of blaming or attributing faults. (समर्थन)
 
 
• **Example:** She supported her friend during the difficult times, ensuring he never felt alone.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Impute'** is **'Support'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Support**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Energetic **(ऊर्जावान): Full of energy, enthusiasm, or vitality.

 
 
• **Example:** The energetic child kept running around the playground for hours.
 
 
 
• **Cheerful **(प्रसन्न): Noticeably happy and optimistic.
 
 
• **Example:** Her cheerful attitude always brightens up the room.
 
 
 
• **Lively **(जीवंत): Full of life and energy; active and outgoing.
 
 
• **Example:** The lively music at the party kept everyone dancing all night.

questions.question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

"They serve food to the guests."

options.text: Food Is served to the guests by them
Food was served to the guests.
Food is being served by them.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "They serve food to the guests."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "food" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "serve" to "is served" (present simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "them."

questions.question:
Choose the correct direct speech form of the following sentence.

They requested to close the door if he was feeling cold.

options.text: He said, "Please closed the door if you are feeling cold."
He said, "Please close the door if you are feeling cold.
He said, "Please close the door if you is feeling cold."
He said, "Please close the door if feel cold."

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** They requested to close the door if he was feeling cold.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"requested to close the door" becomes "Please close the door"**
 
 
• The word "requested" is converted into the polite expression "Please" to match the direct speech format.
 
• The verb "close" is retained in its base form.
 
 
 
• **"if he was feeling cold" becomes "if you are feeling cold"**
 
 
• Pronoun "he" is changed to "you" to match the direct speech pronoun change.
 
• Verb "was" is changed to "are" to match the present tense in direct speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "Please" and ends with a period ".".
 
• Reporting clause precedes the quoted speech and is followed by a comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He said, "Please close the door if you are feeling cold.""*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "He said, "Please closed the door if you are feeling cold."" 

 
 
• The word "closed" is grammatically incorrect as it must be in the base form "close" in direct speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "He said, "Please close the door if you is feeling cold."" 
 
 
• The verb "is" is incorrect as it must be "are" to match the subject "you" in direct speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "He said, "Please close the door if feel cold."" 
 
 
• The clause is incomplete as it omits the subject "you" before "feel cold."
